name: CTA/BOI Report Filer
statute: Corporate Transparency Act — Beneficial Ownership Information Reporting (31 CFR 1010.306)
target_buyer: LLC owners, corporate attorneys, real estate investors, small business owners

icp.company_size: Any size — CTA applies to all reporting companies
icp.trigger: Formed any entity (DOMESTIC or FOREIGN) after Jan 1, 2024 — or existing entities who never filed

detection_signals: Company formed 2024-2026 and never filed BOI
Ownership change after initial filing — update not filed
Company acquired or merged — new beneficial owners not reported
Filing was made but contains incorrect/missing information
Company doesn't know who qualifies as a 'beneficial owner'
questions: What state was it formed in?
How many individuals own 25%+ or exercise substantial control?
Has a BOI report been previously filed with FinCEN?
Has there been any ownership change since the last filing?
fix_deliverables: BOI Report (FinCEN Form 1 or Form 2 for corrections)
enforcement_cases: FinCEN BOI civil penalties: $500/day accruing from Jan 1, 2024
US v. Crypto Index LLC (2025) — first criminal BOI prosecution
NSBA v. Yellen (2024) — temporary injunction, then reinstated
